The most natural and informative next step would be to test a single-variable change from the best configuration. This gives us the cleanest signal about what matters.

I think the most informative test would be to test the fusion strategy (config_039) or the aggregation strategy (config_017).

- The fusion mechanism is a critical design choice that directly affects how multimodal information is combined
